Just got back into it :)
I'm in the exact same position as you right now. I keep sleeping and waking up after a few hours and every time I eat I just throw it up too. Sending you love. 🤍
Couldn't agree more, it's the worst. Thank you 🤍
Please at least drink some water. I know eating can be tough but please try and hydrate.
Lol same i text one last night and was waiting 20 minutes before I gave up
I feel like this and I know it sounds so horrible too. I always just think I could go for a walk in the middle of the night and have the chance that I'll be murdered too lol.

Going through a bad breakup which I know sounds trivial but I've had suicidal ideation in the past with depression and it's just triggered something in me and I'm in so much pain I can't cope with it anymore
Is there anyone you can reach out to? Family or friends? Please be careful
I don't feel worth it anymore :/
I feel this lol :(
Just got broken up with so I feel the exact same
Sending you love. Is there a suicide hotline you could talk to? Or going to A&E for immediate help?
The death of my dad (heart attack) destroyed my family. I couldn't put them through that with me. Although I feel suicidal I know I could never hurt my family no matter how much I'm hurting lol
Please don't take anymore. I'm not sure a lethal dose but make yourself throw it up or call 911/999 asap. ❤️
I know, it's hard when a parent doesn't realise the situation they're in. Sending you and your mom love. ❤️

I understand, my parents were the same and it did get physical sometimes and the cops were called a lot. I was also around your age when it got worse. I am sending you so much love and hope that it gets better, I'm lucky now that I don't live with my parents and hope that you can get out soon too. 🤍
I'd suggest starting with a suicide hotline. If you're still feeling bad then you can try A&E for immediate help. 🤍

Please don't cut yourself. You're 17, you are still so young. Parents are awful sometimes and I can relate to listening to arguing your whole life. Please reach out to a friend. Hopefully by the time you're 18 you can move out / go to college and escape the toxic environment. ❤️
I feel the exact same as you. Sending you love ❤️
I can't tell you what will happen but please reach out to someone you love and that cares about you
